descriptionChirho: The abstract quality or concept of goodness, moral good, or what is beneficial and right, often with the article or in construct with a following genitive.
Good directed toward a person or group as benefit, welfare, or well-being, often with the preposition lamed (for) or possessive suffixes indicating the beneficiary.
The generous goodness or bounty of God, used with second-person pronominal suffixes addressing the Lord.
Concrete instances of good expressed as plural: good things, blessings, or good deeds performed by someone.
